evidence.quote: There's a flywheel that takes fees from the ENTIRE ecosystem and buys the top ten coins. That's a reason to care about who gets there and who can stay there. It doesn't mean every top ten coin is a good buy at any price.
If there's 100 peepee paired against 100 poopoo, and poopoo doubles in dollar value while the pool ratio stays unchanged, peepee's quoted dollar price doubles as well.

items.new_information: 给出总规模测算与仅为竞选承诺、无拨款依据的定性

evidence.quote: BREAKING: President Trump says he will issue a $5,000 "dividend" to every adult citizen in the US if the Republicans win the midterm elections.
There are currently ~245 million US citizens age 18+, meaning this dividend would cost ~$1.2 trillion.
This would mark the biggest economic stimulus payment since the pandemic.
这个事情听着很稀奇，不过从这次讲话和竞选背景看，最直接的目的，还是把共和党保住国会变成一件与选民钱包直接相关的事，争取选票并催促支持者出来投票。但这笔钱目前只是竞选承诺，不是已经获批等待发放的福利。
我们先把Trump说的内容说准确。今天在达拉斯的共和党中期选举大会上，Trump公开承诺，如果共和党能保住众议院和参议院，就向每名成年美国公民发放5000美元，称为Trump Dividend，但要求只能在美国境内消费。注意是每名成年美国公民，不是所有美国居民。
真正困难的不是说出5000，而是回答钱从哪里来。据NPR报道，Trump并没有在讲话中说明完整资金来源，按其承诺的覆盖规模，支出可能达到或超过1万亿美元，这不是一个可以随手从行政经费里挪出来的小项目。
可以用一个纯粹的假设看量级，即使只有2亿人领取，每人5000美元，也要1万亿美元。所以判断能否兑现，应该看的是有没有成文法案，合法拨款依据，明确的受益资格，以及能够对得上的财政安排。如果没有额外收入或相应削减其他支出，这笔新增付款就需要增加借款等融资安排，国家经济强大不能代替这张账。

items.author: ImperiumPaper
items.event: 用边际成本审视增长型代币论述
items.new_information: 给出规模不经济时增长不等于盈利的判据

evidence.quote: But I’ll be more specific to crypto: learn to identify when per-unit costs fall (economies of scale) and when per-unit costs rise (diseconomies of scale).
Well, not always. As you grow, your pool of unconverted users shrinks. The low hanging fruit gets picked.

So growing to profitability usually occurs when scale lends cost advantages, whether it’s from longer manufacturing runs, lower user acquisition costs do to familiarity/reputation, or being able to spread high fixed costs over a broader base.
If no economies of scale are present, it’s very tough to use growth as a strategy to achieve profitability (unless you’re already profitable).
I see this a persistently especially in stablecoins, where the project would have higher profits/smaller losses by shrinking. But it applies to many other projects beyond.

So next time you see a timeline post about how such-and-such can grow to profitability, it’s worth examining if the marginal net income from the next user/dollar/token/whatever is going the right way or the wrong way.

items.event: 对币安Listing策略的三条建议
items.new_information: 把上币标准拆成早期确定性、社区盘与阴谋盘比例三类

evidence.quote: 一. 更早期的发现高确定性资产
有一些Crypto项目，有真实业务和已经验证的长期业务场景。并且有长期的流动性支撑和收入支撑的链上项目。尤其是把收入转化为代币回购会销毁写死在智能合约里，且没有额外智能合约安全性的项目。币安的Listing团队应该更早地配合自己的审计团队确认这些项目的逻辑和安全性，在更低的市值完成Listing。
第二. 更多的支持社区性资产
币安本身自己的链上分析团队，我觉得相比于绝大部分的链上玩家和分析团队来说，更具有专业的分析和资金追溯能力。所以他们完全有能力去更高确定性的分辨：哪些资产是真正的有真实社区，而且筹码相对分散，交易量也相对自然，没有特别多的内幕交易的社区性资产。一旦这个社区性资产的基本要素都能确立的情况下，它的市值高低不应该是限制listing的门槛。反而是留给整个市场去额外博弈的空间。
第三. 阴谋盘完全不能上吗？

这个答案肯定是否定的。高度中心化，有强庄背景的Meme盘，不是不能上，而是在于这个盘子本身的叙事、IP，或者代表的项目本身，有没有更多的外溢性价值空间，比如是否能破圈，带来圈外人员关注？是否能吸引更多的交易人员参与？以及背后庄家和资本背景的风险是否可控？另外还有一个更核心的要素，就是要严格把控这一类代币listing的比例。一旦这个比例过高，就会成为整个社区对币安listing团队指责的核心焦点，把listing团队遇到的的问题变成老鼠仓利益相关方与普通用户的立场对立问题。

items.urgency_reason: 9/15 参议院 cloture 表决前的文本变化，直接影响 DeFi 与预测市场合规预期

evidence.quote: 🚨NEW: Senate Republicans have released updated Clarity Act text reflecting changes negotiated over the August recess.
There appear to be no changes to the ethics section. BRCA and stablecoin yield sections also remain the same.
📌Requiring non-decentralized DeFi protocols to register with the CFTC, which mirrors Section 10301 of the Banking Committee portion of the bill.
📌Limiting the DeFi provisions to spot or cash digital commodity transactions, which appears aimed at addressing concerns raised by tribes about blockchain-based prediction markets.
📌Clarifying the authority of credit unions to deal in crypto.

Crypto journalist Eleanor Terrett reported that Senate Republicans have released an updated version of the CLARITY Act reflecting changes negotiated during the August recess. The ethics, BRCA and stablecoin-yield provisions appear unchanged. Key revisions include requiring non-decentralized DeFi protocols to register with the CFTC, aligning with Section

10301 of the Senate Banking Committee’s version; limiting the DeFi provisions to spot or cash transactions in digital commodities, apparently aimed at addressing tribal concerns over blockchain-based prediction markets; and further clarifying credit unions’ authority to engage in crypto-related activities.

吴说获悉，据加密记者 Eleanor Terrett，美国参议院共和党公布经 8 月休会期协商后的新版 Clarity Act 文本，伦理条款、BRCA 及稳定币收益相关条款未见变化。主要调整包括：要求非去中心化 DeFi 协议向 CFTC 注册，与参议院银行委员会版本第 10301 条保持一致；将 DeFi 条款适用范围限定于数字商品现货或现金交易，旨在回应部落方面对区块链预测市场的担忧；进一步明确信用合作社开展加密业务的权限。https://t.co/yfxK8FJFe7

This updated Clarity Act text reflects bipartisan hard work over August—specifying when decentralized-in-name-only DeFi protocols must register with the CFTC and limiting the DeFi provisions to spot and cash transactions, in response to Native American concerns about prediction markets. Overall, this text contains over 100 changes requested by Democrats.
🚨BREAKING: Senate Republicans are reportedly circulating a revised CLARITY Act text ahead of the September 15 cloture vote.

Democrats have called the current draft insufficient. The cloture vote requires 60 votes.
Republicans hold 53.

evidence.quote: Brew is a Creator Token Launchpad on BNB Chain.

Users can launch a token with one click and choose what the token will trade against. Once launched, it goes directly into a PancakeSwap V3 liquidity pool. There is no Pump.fun-style bonding curve and no “graduation threshold.”

Brew’s approach is to choose the trading pair first and launch directly. Liquidity is permanently locked in the Brew Launcher Factory. The team states that the contracts are open-source and do not contain a function for withdrawing liquidity. The tokens themselves have no buy/sell tax or transfer tax. Revenue comes from PancakeSwap V3 trading fees.
When Creators claim fees, a portion of the corresponding token is automatically burned. The protocol-side fees are used to buy back and burn BREW.

Tokens launched on the platform generate trading fees → when Creators claim fees, a portion of the corresponding token is burned → the protocol collects its fees and uses them to buy back and burn BREW.

Composable trading pairs: A community token can be launched directly against a popular Meme or stock-related asset instead of only BNB.
Dual-pool launches: The same token can serve two different groups of traders through two separate pools.
